fields.name: Build Structure
fields.desc: Construct a building in a domain. Each structure costs gold and takes time to build.

fields.name: Recruit Soldiers
fields.desc: Raise troops from the domain population. Requires barracks and training facilities.

fields.name: Collect Taxes
fields.desc: Gather tax revenue from domain population. Base tax = population x 2gp per household per quarter.

fields.name: Patrol Territory
fields.desc: Send soldiers to patrol hexes and suppress banditry. Reduces monster encounter chance.
fields.cost_formula: 10gp per patrol per hex per month

fields.name: Establish Market
fields.desc: Create a marketplace that generates trade income and attracts merchants.

fields.name: Hold Court
fields.desc: Adjudicate legal disputes and maintain order. Affects loyalty and crime rate.

fields.name: Espionage
fields.desc: Send agents to infiltrate rival domains or gather intelligence.

fields.name: Diplomatic Envoy
fields.desc: Send envoys to negotiate treaties, trade agreements, or alliances with other domains.

fields.name: Fortify Domain
fields.desc: Build walls, towers, and defenses. Increases domain defense value.

fields.name: Explore Hex
fields.desc: Send scouts to explore unclaimed hexes. Reveals resources and threats.
